profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at Nowcom
profile.summary:
I am a experienced Web Developer. Making great ideas happen and solving problems with programming gives a lot of fun to me. 

Always looking for a new challenging role in the field of information technology with the opportunity to work with the latest technology, prove my potential, upgrade my knowledge and grow with the developing organization.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer Team Lead
positions.description:
• Work in a team responsible for developing and maintaining the front-end of corporate websites
• Create clean, cross-browser-compatible markup utilizing HTML5, CSS3 and JavaScript
• Collaborate to solve problems and produce innovative solutions with the team
• Work with other developers, manager, business owners, designers, as well as specialists in UX, content, social media, SEO & SEM on a variety of web projects
• Familiarity with the modern web
• Experience building WordPress CMS websites using the best & de-facto standard plugins.
• Strong knowledge working with WordPress at a PHP code level.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Responsible for the design, layout and coding of the websites and web applications. Involve in the technical and code implementation as well as maintenance and updates of an existing application.

positions.title: Web Programmer
positions.locationName: Summit 1 tower, shaw boulevard, madaluyong city
positions.description:
Ensure to meet clients satisfaction by delivering and bringing a custom design and quality website based on their needs. working both front and back end development, handling multiple projects in a fast pace environment and enable to meet deadlines.

As a Web Developer : 

- Guarding the consistency of the design (fonts, colors, buttons, forms, sizing, alignments) made by the designers in order to work smoothly and lessen the page load interval.

- Bringing the designed PSD's to web standards using HTML5 / CSS3 / Javascript / Jquery, concerning with the proper development method of building CMS, making design into responsive and cross check.

As a Web Programmer :

- Creating the whole functionalities of the website with the intergration of different API's, plugins and payment methods.

- Build custom theme for wordpress, custom backend dashboard for laravel and Design MySQL database Layout.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Producing website for the company and their affiliates. Managing company network and offer technical assistance.
•	Hired to quickly build company website. Designed and created website base on the company needs and demands.

•	Handle company network and offer technical assistance in the company.

•	Designed company logo. Designed a set of logos and officially used by the company.

positions.title: Jr. Web Developer
positions.description:
Developed and maintained company intranet database management system. Handled and processed raw file in excel format for the database update. Collaborated with Graphic Designers to build and maintained client’s website.
•	Created online tools to process thousands of data in the database every day, contains file upload in XLS format for insertion of data’s and CSV format for fetching data’s, also generation of reports in PDF format.

•	Created real-time online employee attendance monitoring system connected to corporate biometrics.

•	Converted PSD files into HTML.

projects.title: Bloom Magic
projects.description: Bloom Magic was founded to help local florists thrive in an increasingly competitive online environment. As a trusted marketplace, Bloom Magic puts our local partners completely in control, allowing them to offer their own original designs and unique creations directly to customers. This is not the case with other flower websites which force florists to adapt to generic designs. Whether you're looking for a bouquet of roses or a one of kind design, Bloom Magic lets you discover the perfect gift for that special person.  With our growing community of local partners and our dedicated team of customer service agents, Bloom Magic is the simplest and most reliable way to order quality flowers online.

projects.title: GoFundMyTeam
projects.description:
GoFundMyTeam is an online fundraising platform for organizations in the Youth, HS and College Sports Teams, Non-Profit, High School Performing Arts, PTO's for Elementary, Middle and Junior High Schools and Church Groups for Mission Trips. This unique online platform allows organizations to fund significant dollars with little time and reach connections beyond the local market. We customize every Email Campaign with Logo's and Images of our clients so they can send out custom donor email messages out to their best supporters. No more selling stuff with low profit percentages and we just eliminated all the hassle in organizing from start to finish in selling items. With our platform it only takes the organization a few minutes and for parents it's less than 20 minutes to start to finish!! We are not just selling a fundraising solution...WE ARE GIVING YOU YOUR TIME BACK! Guaranteed 88% or more on every donation received. Our goal is to disrupt the way normal fundraising is done in the verticals and give back the profit percentage to the groups and organizations where it belongs.
GoFundMyBand, GoFundTheArts, FundyMe, Fund4Abilities, GoFundMyOrg.
